2: axis tick / spin digit of the Qt viewer
3: axis tick / spin digit of the Qt viewer
5: axis tick / spin digit of the Qt viewer
6: axis tick / spin digit of the Qt viewer
7: axis tick / spin digit of the Qt viewer
allofthem: Qt RegionEditor combine choice 'All of them'; emtk's shared RegionControls offers the same rule as the combine choice 'and'.
anyofthem: Qt RegionEditor combine choice 'Any of them'; emtk: combine choice 'or'.
blur: normalisation option of the Qt ImageView
cividis: colormap menu entry of the Qt ImageView, not offered by the shared ImageCanvas
combine: Qt RegionEditor combine label; emtk: 'Combine regions'.
divide: normalisation option of the Qt ImageView
exactlyone: Qt RegionEditor combine choice 'Exactly one'; emtk: combine choice 'xor'.
gray: in emtk's colormap list (shown when opened)
inferno: in emtk's colormap list (shown when opened)
mean: normalisation option of the Qt ImageView
measurement: column header of the Qt region table (area / mean); emtk shows the area and mean of the selected region only for image regions, not for plane regions.
menu: pyqtgraph ImageView Menu button (ROI / normalisation options).
noregions: Qt placeholder 'No regions'; emtk shows the selection summary line ('N of M px') instead.
off: normalisation 'off' option of the Qt ImageView
operation: pyqtgraph ImageView normalisation (subtract/divide/blur of a frame range): a display tool, not part of the analysis.
plasma: colormap menu entry of the Qt ImageView, not offered by the shared ImageCanvas
region: column header of the Qt region table; emtk lists each region as a selectable row with Enabled and Invert boxes.
roi: pyqtgraph ImageView ROI button (line-profile ROI of the viewer); the emtk image has none.
shape: column header of the Qt region table (Rectangle / Ellipse / Polygon); emtk names the shape in the region's row and its Add buttons.
subtract: normalisation option of the Qt ImageView
t: axis label (frame index) of the Qt ImageView; the emtk movie has Play, Loop, Stop and a frame slider
timerange: time-range widget of the Qt ImageView normalisation
turbo: colormap menu entry of the Qt ImageView, not offered by the shared ImageCanvas
viridis: colormap menu of the Qt ImageView; the shared emtk ImageCanvas offers magma, inferno, viridis and gray
x: axis letters of the Qt viewer; emtk draws 'x [px]' and 'y [px]'
y: axis letters of the Qt viewer; emtk draws 'x [px]' and 'y [px]'
firstaxis: an option of a Qt choice list; emtk's field lists the same options when it is opened (the capture shows the lists closed; each is picked in the tests).
gateregions: Qt title of the region list; emtk's shared region list has its own header 'Analysis regions'.
nodetectors: Qt setup picker placeholder; replaced by the Detectors tab (the shared Setup editor).
—rawdetectorchannels—: Qt setup picker placeholder 'raw detector channels'; with no detector window the raw channels are used and the Detectors tab shows none.
